phaseUnits: cycle normalized0..1 driven by real rendered root path distance / parent stride20, not elapsed frame time

swingPathProposal.horizontal: smoothstep5(u)=6u^5-15u^4+10u^3 from previous trailing release to next leading landing; each physical step is a render assumption
swingPathProposal.vertical: small sin(pi*u)^2 hump, optional physical height≈3; keep pad flat because no underside source exists
swingPathProposal.sourceFootPitch: Keep source foot flat/front-oriented. Rotating a foot to show an unseen sole is not authored support.

footLockProposal: During stance retain each projected world-ground plant, transform by actual root movement; do not drag every foot with body centre.
Release exactly one leg at a time. At landing start new stance plant; never teleport to a nominal paw offset.
Body COM hints are support-plane projected assumptions, not visible body-centre or actual mass calculation.
On movement stop do not advance a walking clock endlessly. Preserve planted feet and complete a safe active recovery smoothly if parent chooses, without adding Core movement/actions.
notCoreLocomotion: No time unit/resource/collision/ground simulation or distance implementation is performed in this metadata.
Only FRONT display is considered. Shared front parts do not author left/right/back views or guarantee slope contacts.
